name: Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells infusion and non-infusion pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company operates through Chuanning, Botai, and Other Business segments.
